title: Sweet young thing down there. Photo girl
html_source:
Alec Bannon reports in a card that he has met Milly Bloom. Milly is Leopold and Molly Bloom’s fifteen year old daughter.

In Chapter 18 we learn that Mr. Bloom sent her away to study photography.

Molly thinks that Mr. Bloom sent Milly away so that she wouldn’t be in the way of her and Boylan.
